title: Trillioner
tagline: One toy city, one day, one trillion dollars. Spend it all before 6AM, if your money lets you.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: Solo runs work offline. Battle Spend: host a room and share the 4-letter code; bots fill seats.

multiplayer.notes: Solo runs entirely in the browser. Battle Spend rooms run on the game's own WebSocket server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start), which decides every purchase. Design: games/trillioner/docs/DESIGN.md.
